materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo from outside a white weatherboard house, close-up of a timber casement window that has been levered open. The window is pushed shut but the brass latch is ripped off and hangs by one screw, and the white-painted timber frame beside it has deep gouges with bare wood showing. Trampled plants in the garden bed below the sill. Overcast day. Only the window and a little cladding are in view; closed curtains behind the glass. No people, no text, no logos.

triage.rationale: Forced bedroom window, nothing taken, nobody hurt, no other party, the window screwed shut and the home habitable. The photo, a complete builder's quote (NZD 977.50 including GST) and the Police record with its event reference are all in, and every required question is answerable. Main's theft branch also lists proof of ownership; nothing was taken and the claim is for the building, so the pack treats the photo, the repair quote and the Police record as the required materials. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).
